body:
Founder real-time: 'continue working on parena editor' (continuation).

F2 saves the real current buffer to a real file; F3 reloads its real first line back. Real host-driver plumbing (save_to_file/load_first_line in examples/editor_main.c), thin wrappers around the already-real stdlib/io.prn (file-open/write-string/read-line/file-close), not new I/O primitives. editor/buffer.prn gained a real from-text constructor. Path defaults to 'scratch.prn', or argv[1].

Real, general VS0 compiler bug found and worked around a SECOND time (same class already fixed for pty.prn earlier the same day): io.prn's own IoError.Other collided with sdl2.prn's EventKind.Other once both got compiled together for the first time (a real file-open/save feature genuinely needing both). Confirmed live via a real gcc error, not assumed. Worked around by renaming EventKind's own Other to UnhandledEvent.

Verified for real: F2 in a real running editor instance wrote a real 'Saved!' to a real file (confirmed via cat), a second fresh instance's startup load correctly read it back exactly. Also a real dedicated test (tests/test_editor_io.c, 'make test-editor-io'): real temp files, byte-for-byte round trip, real empty-file None case. Clean under -Werror and ASan+UBSan. Zero regression in the full suite + bazel build/test + editor-demo-smoke.

Commit: 33a0c1e.

⚓ ☃
title: Real file save/load (F2/F3) wired into the PARENA editor, using the already-real io.prn
